evals.name: account-withdrawal-behavior-tests
evals.prompt: Add tests for Account::withdraw in tests/AccountTest.php. It should allow withdrawing the available balance, reject one dollar beyond the balance, and keep the original balance when the withdrawal is rejected. Use the existing Pest style.
evals.expected_output: Writes readable Pest tests with behavior-shaped names, concrete Money values, visible Arrange / Act / Assert shape, and specific assertions for result and balance state.

assertions.text: Names tests after withdrawal behavior and outcome
Uses concrete boundary values for exact balance and beyond balance
Asserts both rejection reason and unchanged balance for the failure case

evals.name: legacy-rounding-characterization
evals.prompt: Before refactoring LegacyInvoiceCalculator, add a characterization test for the current pre-2025 tax rounding behavior. Nobody is sure if it is right, but old invoices must not change while we refactor.
evals.expected_output: Routes to legacy guidance, writes a characterization test that labels uncertainty, explains why behavior is pinned, and avoids presenting the current behavior as a permanent domain rule.

assertions.text: Includes rationale for preserving current legacy behavior during refactor
Does not treat unknown legacy behavior as a timeless product rule

evals.name: hard-to-test-payment-service
evals.prompt: I need tests for PaymentService. It constructs StripeClient internally, reads Date.now(), and sends receipts in the same method that calculates invoice totals. Please just mock whatever is needed.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the production code is hard to observe, recommends decomposing calculation, clock, gateway, and receipt boundaries before adding broad mocks, then suggests focused tests and adapter checks.

assertions.text: Recommends improving production boundaries instead of only adding broad mocks
Does not expose private internals only for tests

evals.name: review-vague-mock-heavy-tests
evals.prompt: Review this diff: tests are named 'works' and 'handles error', most assertions are assertTrue/assertNotNull, and the order repository mock expects five internal calls. Is that okay?
evals.expected_output: Uses severity-first review, calls out misleading tests, weak assertions, and brittle implementation coupling, then suggests behavior names, observable assertions, and narrower doubles.

assertions.text: Prioritizes behavior gaps and brittleness before style nits
Identifies vague names and weak assertions as maintainability problems

evals.name: named-parameterized-edge-cases
evals.prompt: Convert these three copied validation tests into a parameterized test: empty email, malformed email, and email longer than 255 characters. Keep it readable for onboarding.
evals.expected_output: Creates a parameterized test with named cases that explain each boundary, keeps expected outcomes visible, and avoids an opaque anonymous data table.

assertions.text: Uses named dataset or case labels for each email boundary
Keeps the expected validation result visible
Does not hide all behavior in a generic helper
